summary_ja: リスク・アセットの額に対するCET1バッファー比率の算式を規定し、TLAC規制対象の最終指定親会社等については例外規定と追加控除項目を設ける条文。
summary_en: Prescribes the formula for the CET1 buffer ratio relative to risk-weighted assets, with a special exception and additional deduction items for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies subject to TLAC requirements.
